description: Behaviour cases for branching-strategy-designer (6 cases, domain-specific).

cases.prompt: Our branching and release flow is undefined - choose and record a strategy.

assertions: Produces a decision record with context, a chosen model, alternatives and rules; does not claim to change repository settings.
Does not claim an inspection or execution it did not perform.
Lists open questions and unverified items.

cases.prompt: Decide trunk-based versus release branching for our team and record the trade-offs.

assertions: Compares the two models against the supplied team/release constraints and states a recommendation with rejected options.
Reports a conflict only when the inspected evidence shows one; this prompt supplies none, so it records "no conflict established" rather than inventing one.

cases.prompt: Design branch naming, protection and review rules with a migration path.

assertions: Provides the rule table and a migration plan that handles open branches and states the rollback.
Defines the concrete validation/evidence step that would prove the artifact.

cases.prompt: Ci pipeline architect work: handle the deliverable end-to-end for our system.

assertions: Routes the request to the real neighbouring owner named in the prompt.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: Our hotfix flow during release freeze is unclear - design the branching decision record.

assertions: Designs the hotfix/release path explicitly and records the decision; no live settings edit claimed.
Lists the evidence needed before the artifact can be treated as a decision.

cases.prompt: We are moving to trunk-based - record the rules, merge strategy and migration risks.

assertions: Refuses to assume facts or skip a required safety/evidence step.
States what is missing and what the authorized human owner must provide.
Does not claim to have run or implemented anything.
